address: GL 7 & 8 Ground Floor - Haza Bin Zayed the 1st Street - Marina Mall, Abu Dhabi
bio: You can expect all the smart and elegant attributes found in Cipriani establishments, with a slight twist. This spot on the ground floor of Marina Mall is open for breakfast, brunch, lunch and small bites along with some daily specials and even pizza. They also have a fine selection of cakes, patisseries and some delicious house-made ice creams - perfect for a sweet treat when doing a little shopping.
